d: Known as a 'fixer' for difficult clients, a talented party planner must help a young CEO plan the Christmas party of the year to dazzle the mayor and save his company. Wil the 'fixer' fix something more than just the company?

Life-long best friends Sarah, Cat and Riley reunite in Sarah's childhood home to cook up some Christmas magic and save the holidays for their families. With each friend at a different crossroad, they will all have to come together to rediscover the Christmas magic that can only happen in the house on Holly Lane.

Oliver Stone dives into modern American history in this epic film, as New Orleans DA Jim Garrison uncovers hidden truths about the Kennedy assassination beyond the official version. Kevin Costner stars alongside an outstanding cast.
